options.description: The tree: a list, drawn from the left margin, or one root node whose children hang from it -- as `selectTree()` reads them. A `State` or a `Computed` of either is followed.
options.name: items

options.description: Draw with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says.
options.name: ascii

options.description: The current node, as its value, or the state that holds it -- the shape `ListView`'s `current` has. Left out, the cursor starts on the first row.
options.name: current

options.description: Whether a node is disabled: drawn muted, passed over by the cursor, not activated and never ticked. A disabled branch's twisty still opens and closes it, because disabled says the node cannot be picked, not that what is under it cannot be seen.
options.name: disabled

options.description: What to show when there are no nodes. Defaults to `ListView`'s "Nothing to show".
options.name: empty

options.description: The open branches, as a set of values, or the state that holds them.
options.name: expanded

options.description: Type-to-find over the nodes' text, as `ListView`'s. Off by default.
options.name: find

options.description: The lines between nodes, `plain` or `rounded`. Defaults to `plain`.
options.name: guide

options.description: Whether more than one node can be ticked, as `ListView`'s. Defaults to `false`.
options.name: multiple

options.description: Called with the current node's value and the node on Enter or a double-click.
options.name: onActivate

options.description: The host box's own props: a height, a border, a class.
options.name: props

options.description: Draws a node's text: an element, or a string drawn as one line. The guide and the twisty are drawn in front of it either way. Called when the row comes into view and again when the node, its depth, or whether it is open changes.
options.name: row

options.description: Whether to draw a scrollbar. Defaults to `true`.
options.name: scrollbar

options.description: The ticked nodes, for a `multiple` tree, as `ListView`'s `selected`.
options.name: selected

options.description: `ListView`'s `j`/`k`/`g`/`G`, and `h` and `l` for Left and Right. Off by default.
options.name: vim

registryDescription: A tree list view: a focusable tree that opens and closes, selects by value, and reads children lazily
